notes.measure: Each award as defined in claude/AWARDS_DEFINITIONS_2026-11-14.md (modules/awards), through each season's own regular season (season_structure regular_through).
notes.wins_swung: Counted against the official weekly scores (all_matchups); his own started points from the league log.
notes.missing_days: The league log misses whole days in some weeks (checks.short_weeks): no PAR is counted on them.
notes.most_improved: League-log FPPG (games on a league roster) for this season and the usual level; there are no daily NBA lines before 2026-27.
notes.trades: data/historical/all_trades.json; each side's players' PAR plus each draft pick it got at the average PAR of players taken in that round (est.; data/historical/DRAFT_ROUND_VALUES.json); picks for a 2020 or earlier draft listed, not valued.
notes.pickups: No transaction log before 2026-27: a pickup is a stint on a roster that doesn't begin on opening day and isn't a trade arrival (all_trades.json, completed trades); the add day is its first logged day. The drop shows only when the daily rosters make it unambiguous (one arrival and one departure that day).
notes.rookies: His first NBA season played in data/historical/NBA_SEASONS.json; config/ROOKIE_SEASONS.json is checked against it and NBA_SEASONS wins where they disagree (checks.rookies.disagree).
notes.bust: The expectation is his previous NBA season's FPPG (NBA_SEASONS, 10+ games in it): no preseason projection was stored before 2026-27, and the pick order is punted through 2023-24. His actual is that season's whole NBA line. 2018-19 has no draft list.
notes.potw_seasons: Player of the Week history starts in 2025-26 (config/POTW_HISTORY.json); weeks without points take them from the league log.
notes.managers: modules/manager_awards: Lineup manager of the year (fill rate), Draft of the year (drafted players' PAR, keepers apart), Waiver king (all pickups' PAR), Unluckiest season (losses in weeks above the league median). Regular season only.
notes.best: Records' tiles: a season's PAR total (MVP, Rookie of the Year, Draft of the year, Waiver king) is ranked per regular-season week; the rest by their own measure.
